title: P2P Local File Share Server Pro (.NET 8 / WPF / WinUI 3)
target_os: Windows 10 / Windows 11 (x64 Native Executable / Single-File Self-Contained .exe)
overview: A zero-configuration, high-throughput local area network (LAN) file-sharing server and P2P distribution workstation engineered with .NET 8.0, WPF / WinUI 3, Wpf.Ui / Fluent Design, and an embedded ASP.NET Core Kestrel HTTP/2 web engine. Empowers users to share multi-gigabyte files instantly with mobile phones, tablets, and remote PCs on the same Wi-Fi/LAN via dynamic QR code scanning, PIN-code authentication, upload portal dropzones, and real-time chunked byte streaming.
key_features: High-Performance Embedded Kestrel HTTP/2 Server: In-process ASP.NET Core Kestrel Web API server hosting chunked static file streaming and multipart file upload endpoints with zero external dependencies
Dynamic Local IP & Vector QR Code Engine: Automatic network interface detection (Ethernet, Wi-Fi, Virtual Adapters) paired with QRCoder vector QR code generation pointing directly to LAN endpoints
PIN-Code Access Protection & Rate Limiting: Configurable 4-to-8 digit PIN authentication, Session Token cookies, rate limiting, and temporary IP bans to prevent unauthorized LAN downloads

Interactive LAN Upload Portal & Drag-and-Drop Dropzone: Mobile-friendly HTML5/Tailwind web interface served directly by Kestrel, allowing connected mobile clients to upload files back to the desktop app

Real-Time Transfer Speedometers & Active Session Monitor: WPF/WinUI 3 reactive dashboard displaying active client IP addresses, real-time MB/s throughput speedometers, transferred byte counters, and connection logs

core_stack.gui_framework: WPF / WinUI 3 with Wpf.Ui (Fluent Dark Theme / Windows 11 Mica Glass Effects)
core_stack.web_server_engine: Microsoft.AspNetCore.App (Embedded Kestrel Web API / Minimal API Core)
core_stack.qr_engine: QRCoder 1.4.3+ (Native Bitmap & SVG QR Vector Generator)
core_stack.packaging: MSBuild / dotnet publish (PublishSingleFile=true, SelfContained=true, IncludeNativeLibrariesForSelfExtract=true producing standalone ~45MB .exe)

design_system_and_theme.theme_name: Hyper Emerald & Deep Slate (Windows 11 Mica / Fluent Grid)

typography.font_family: Segoe UI Variable Display, Cascadia Code, Inter, sans-serif

system_architecture.pattern: Model-View-ViewModel (MVVM) with Embedded Kestrel Async Service Host
system_architecture.ui_layer: WPF / WinUI 3 XAML markup with Wpf.Ui Fluent dark controls, responsive card grid, embedded SVG QR code canvas, active client session list, and live MB/s throughput gauges
system_architecture.background_server_host: Microsoft.AspNetCore.Builder.WebApplication running on background Task hosting Minimal APIs (/api/files, /api/upload, /api/stream/{id}, /ws/telemetry) with zero UI thread locking
system_architecture.ipc_and_event_bus: System.Threading.Channels (Channel<ServerEvent>) streaming atomic client download/upload progress, byte counters, and connection events to ViewModel via IProgress<T>
system_architecture.process_safety: Memory-safe managed C# 12 buffer pipelines, zero raw pointer risks, strict Kestrel request body size limits, and graceful shutdown handles on application exit

ai_agent_prompt:
You are an elite Senior Windows Desktop & Systems Software Engineer tasked with implementing a production-grade native C# / .NET 8 desktop application titled 'P2P Local File Share Server Pro'.

### PROJECT OBJECTIVE:
Construct a zero-configuration local area network file sharing workstation and web server using .NET 8.0, WPF / WinUI 3 (Wpf.Ui Fluent Design), and an embedded ASP.NET Core Kestrel HTTP/2 engine. Enables instant multi-device file transfers via dynamic QR code scanning, PIN security, upload portal dropzones, and real-time MB/s throughput monitoring without freezing the desktop UI.

### MANDATORY TECHNICAL REQUIREMENTS:
1. .NET 8.0 ARCHITECTURE & MVVM PATTERN:
   - Built with C# 12 and .NET 8.0 LTS using CommunityToolkit.Mvvm ([ObservableProperty], [RelayCommand]).
   - Styled using Wpf.Ui or WinUI 3 applying Fluent Dark theme tokens (#070B10 dark background, #10B981 emerald primary accent, #06B6D4 cyan accent) with Windows 11 Mica glass visual effects.

2. EMBEDDED KESTREL WEB ENGINE & NETWORK DISCOVERY:
   - Host an in-process ASP.NET Core WebApplication (Kestrel) on configurable ports (e.g., 8080, 5000).
   - Automatically enumerate active IPv4 addresses across network adapters (Ethernet, Wi-Fi) using NetworkInterface and UnicastIPAddressInformation.
   - Generate vector QR codes using QRCoder pointing directly to the active LAN URL (e.g., http://192.168.1.50:8080).

3. PIN PROTECTION & UPLOAD PORTAL:
   - Implement PIN-code authentication middleware requiring connected mobile browsers to enter a matching 4-digit PIN before downloading shared files.
   - Serve an embedded mobile-responsive HTML5/CSS upload web portal allowing connected devices to upload files back to the desktop application's destination folder.

4. REAL-TIME TELEMETRY & EVENT STREAMING:
   - Pass atomic byte transfer events, client IP connections, throughput speed calculations (MB/s), and active session logs to the UI using System.Threading.Channels and IProgress<T> without locking the main UI thread.

5. SINGLE-FILE PACKAGING:
   - Deliver complete C# source files (MainWindow.xaml, MainWindow.xaml.cs, MainViewModel.cs, KestrelServerService.cs) and a ready-to-publish .csproj configured for PublishSingleFile=true self-contained .exe output.
